Laundry Timer

Two independent side-by-side timers for washer (35 min) and dryer (45 min) cycles, each with custom lengths and alarms.

🧺 Washer

0:00

🌀 Dryer

0:00

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a preset or custom length for the washer.
  2. Do the same for the dryer.
  3. Start each timer as you load the machine.
  4. Each timer alarms independently when done.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can both timers run at the same time?

Yes — the washer and dryer timers run completely independently, each with its own start, pause and reset.

What presets are available?

Washer 35 / 45 / 60 minutes and dryer 45 / 60 / 90 minutes, plus any custom length from 1 to 300 minutes.

Will I hear the alarm?

Keep this tab open with your volume on — each timer plays its own alarm when its cycle ends.
